dialogue.user: a new pair of shoes and I'm browsing around. I'm particularly interested in athletic shoes that prioritize comfort. Could you show me some options within my budget of $100 to $200?
dialogue.agent:
Here are some athletic shoe options within your budget of $100 to $200 that prioritize comfort:

* **Under Armour Men's HOVR Sonic 6 Running Shoe** ($110.00, 4.7/5, 7 reviews) - Features a soft, springy UA HOVR cushioning and an engineered mesh upper for comfort and breathability.
* **Nike Quest 2 Ti Womens Shoes** ($121.90, 4.6/5, 1 review) 
* **Mizuno Women's Wave Hurricane 2 Volleyball Shoe** ($100.00, 4.5/5, 7 reviews) - Offers traction and comfort for volleyball players.
* **ASICS Women's Gel-Fujitrabuco 6** ($130.00, 4.4/5, 24 reviews) - Features a trail-specific outsole and rear foot GEL Cushioning Technology for cushioning and responsiveness.
* **Nike Ashin Modern Women's Shoes** ($108.99, 4.2/5, 11 reviews) - Has a lightweight, breathable mesh upper and a slimmed-down silhouette for a sleek look.

Would you like to know more about any of these options or would you like me to show you more options?

products.title: Under Armour Men's HOVR Sonic 6 Running Shoe
products.description: Built insanely light and supportive so nothing will hold you back the second coach blows that whistle. Paired with soft, springy UA HOVR™ cushioning that pushes you forward—you'll crush those run drills., Engineered mesh upper with seamless forefoot for comfort & breathability. External heel counter for lightweight structure & added lockdown. 3D-molded sockliner cradles the foot for enhanced step-in comfort. Responsive UA HOVR™ cushioning reduces impact, returns energy & helps propel you forward. products.title: ECCO Women's Flowt Strap Sandal
products.description: Expertly made from a combination of premium ecco leathers and set on a contrasting white sole, this open-toe ecco flowt women's sandal is an elevated take on a classic warm-weather footwear silhouette. The pretty ankle strap gives you a confident and secure fit, the leather lining ensures breathable comfort and the premium leather upper adds a distinctive feminine twist.

products.title: ASICS Women's Gel-Fujitrabuco 6
products.description: A long-time favorite of off-road runners, our newly updated, lighter-weight GEL-Fuji Trabuco 6 is ready to hit the trails. GEL-Fuji Trabuco 6 has made its name with a winning blend of cushioning, responsiveness and versatile traction. Get up to speed with a trail-specific outsole, Rear foot GEL Cushioning Technology and protective toe bumper for the roughest ground. An Ortholite sock liner provides immediate step-in comfort, while a lace garage and gusseted tongue ensure a secure, debris-free fit. Enhanced performance is built in throughout the shoe, while a more rugged mesh provides added durability. GEL-Fuji Trabuco 6 is a shoe warrior that not only beckons you to go off road, but equips you for success.

products.title: Dunham Men's Clyde Plaintoe Oxford
products.description: Classic styling with a modern twist, Dunham’s Clyde collection brings versatility and comfort to the office or beyond. Premium leather uppers and soft leather linings make these wearable styles perfect for those occasions when you have to look your best. And the removable dual-density foot bed with stability cradle combines with a cushioned outsole for all-day support and comfort. Built for men who are equally at-home in a business suit or jeans, these good looking shoes are certain to become the first pair you reach for each morning. Work life balance solved. Also available in a wide range of extended sizes and widths (D, 2E, 4EE) to deliver the perfect fit.

products.title: Nike Ashin Modern Women's Shoes
products.description: Crafted with all-day comfort in mind, the Nike Ashin Modern Run Women's Shoe features a lightweight, breathable mesh upper and a slimmed-down silhouette for a sleek, fast look on the street. Design details like a repeating "NIKE" logo on the tongue webbing offer can't-miss style.
